claim: The source comments the video interrupt pin as CB2, above the PIA2 equate.
The PIA1 comment block pins CA1 as an IRQ line.
ROMF8 co-loads at ORG $FB00, marked TEMPORARY by the author.
The build notes warn BEWARE OF ORDER OF LOADING for the co-loaded upper half.
APVCT EQU $FC60 is the appearance-vector origin SAMEXAP7 assembles at.
WDOG EQU $C3FC is the watchdog address the source strokes.
The ledger names the GREEN software release.

source.verbatim: ROM1B, ROM2A, ROM3B, ROM4B, AND ROM6A THRU ROM12A ARE THE GREEN SOFTWARE

claim: GREEN is the re-cut for two 2716 EPROMs instead of one 2532 at $D000.

source.verbatim: (2ND RELEASE FOR 2 2716'S INSTEAD OF 1 2532 AT D000)
